hero.headline: <hl>Understand why</hl> every month feels like there’s <hl>no money left</hl> over.
hero.subheadline: Small purchases add up without you noticing. Track where it’s really going, and know what you have left before the month runs out — then start setting some aside for a rainy day.
hero.tagline: Free forever, no ads — start saving right away.

track.title: Track everything
track.description: Log income and expenses, organized into categories you control.

monthly.description: See income, expenses, and your net position for any month at a glance.

recurring.title: Recurring made easy
recurring.description: Set up salary, rent, or subscriptions once — they show up automatically every month.

backup.title: Your data, backed up
backup.description: Export everything to CSV any time, and restore it in a couple of clicks whenever you need to.
